commits.body:
All sixteen disclosed public callers were compiled to their locked class digest. Each of 54 input histories ran on each original deployment through the ordinary application loader and a separate resource-recording loader before solving. The receipts bind startup, class origins, resource lookups, ordered providers, expected results, controls and the point where the frozen automatic scaffolding stopped. Batik opened its parser properties and service registrations. The dom4j factory loaded in its original namespace. All 30 affected test groups passed.

Five jobs remeasure the unchanged automatic selector with the successor checker and the original signed packets. Both calibration JARs were reconstructed byte for byte, all 64 frozen candidate records passed the comparator cross-check, and job schemas validated. commits.summary: Bind local manifest lookups to public proofs (verification pending)
commits.body:
Eleven of sixteen disclosed release pairs qualified both finite questions on the original application verifier. The remaining five reached the correct production methods but declared local manifest JARs that were absent. Bind those negative lookups to the selected launch and cache, defer cache writes until they are rechecked, and keep additional or reordered providers open. A signed declaration may revisit an already bound JAR or the immediate next explicit provider. Batik now qualifies all eight entries in its two-width gradient claim in a capped probe. All 49 affected test groups and the test inventory passed.

Recheck cold, warm, clean and wrong expectations on the six original XML and manifest-bearing release pairs. Also insert a real resource at a formerly missing path, explicitly bind it, and restore the original graph. Jobs 20261124-232633-manifest-bound-public-entries-for-slot-0, 20261124-232649-04-manifest-bound-release-and-negative-c, 20261124-232650-08-manifest-bound-release-and-negative-c, 20261124-232650-10-manifest-bound-release-and-negative-c, 20261124-232650-13-manifest-bound-release-and-negative-c, 20261124-232650-16-manifest-bound-release-and-negative-c and 20261124-232650-appearance-manifest-bound-release-and-ne.
